quests.desc: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, try to take a trip west. Then, retrieve the latchkey from the mantle. With the latchkey, make an effort to venture east. Okay, and then, unlock the door. Then, ensure that the door inside the bathroom is open. And then, try to move east. Then, head north. And then, make an attempt to go east. And then, move north. Then, go east. And then, make an attempt to go north. Then, attempt to venture west. And then, go west. Then, open the gate inside the playroom. Having pulled open the gate, go south. And then, go to the west. And then, make an effort to go south. With that over with, lift the insect from the floor of the cookery. That's it!

objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Your first objective is to travel west. And then, retrieve the latchkey from the mantle inside the austere workshop. After that, go to the east. After that, look and see that the door is unlocked. And then, ensure that the door is open. After that, make an attempt to take a trip east. And then, make an effort to venture north. After that, make an attempt to go east. And then, make an effort to go north. Following that, make an effort to go to the east. Next, make an effort to go north. Then, move west. Next, attempt to head west. Then, make sure that the gate inside the playroom is wide open. After that, travel south. And then, move west. With that over with, attempt to take a trip south. And then, retrieve the insect from the floor of the cookery. That's it!
